instruction: Use the system settings menu to activate the automatic screen lock feature immediately when the screen blanks.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic screen lock. The evaluator uses gsettings to read the lock-enabled value and expects it to be 'true\n'. Similar to the original task which checks a GNOME desktop setting, but this is a boolean setting instead of a numeric one.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts screen lock state using gsettings command
Metric performs appropriate exact comparison for boolean setting verification
Expected value 'true\n' correctly includes newline character matching gsettings output format
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the lock-enabled setting as required by instruction
Semantic flow is correct: instruction requires enabling automatic screen lock → getter reads lock-enabled setting → metric checks for exact match with 'true\n'
